cells.title: Prove real_bee children ignore a user-global team config
cells.action: Verify rbgi-1 independently, then add one test to packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/tests/pi_plugin_contracts.rs whose name starts with real_bee_ (C1). The test writes a user-global config.json that sets team.claude.extraction to kind herding with an agent, under a temp folder, and starts a fixture bee through real_bee with XDG_CONFIG_HOME and HOME pointed at that temp folder (so the global layer would load if real_bee did not isolate it). It runs dispatch prepare --runtime claude --kind gather --role extraction --json in a fixture whose tracked config sets team.claude.extraction model haiku, and asserts tool Agent and payload.model haiku.
